# Profile assets

The README uses local SVGs so its banner and project cards do not depend on a
third-party image service. Text and links stay in the README; edit `assets/hero.svg`
for the banner and `assets/project-*.svg` for the project cards.

## Contribution snake

`snake.yml` generates light and dark SVGs from the repository owner's real GitHub
contributions. It runs daily at 03:17 UTC (06:17 in Türkiye), when the README or
workflow is pushed to `main`, or through **Actions → Snake Animation
→ Run workflow**. It commits only the two snake SVGs back to `main` using the
built-in `GITHUB_TOKEN`; no personal access token or `output` branch is needed.

Both SVGs are also checked in, so the README can display them before the first
workflow run. The file paths in the workflow and README must remain identical.

If updates stop, check the workflow run log. GitHub Actions must be enabled, and
repository policies must allow the workflow's `contents: write` permission and
bot pushes to `main`. GitHub can disable scheduled workflows in public repositories
after 60 days without activity; re-enable the schedule from the Actions tab.

## Motion and accessibility

The banner is a script-free SVG with CSS animation and a reduced-motion variant.
All images have alternative text, and project links work without animation.
The snake SVGs are generated by [Platane/snk](https://github.com/Platane/snk).
